sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

The Applicant has filed this Application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for enlarging the Applicant on Regular Bail in connection with FIR being C.R. No.
11191045221193/2023 registered with Sola High Court Police Station, Ahmedabad for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Section 12 of the Passport Act.

entities.label: COURT

2. Heard learned Senior Advocate Mr. Harshit S. Tolia appearing with learned Advocate Mr.
Saurabh J. Mehta for the Applicant and learned APP Mr. Manan Mehta for the Respondent - State.
3.
Learned Advocate for the Applicant has submitted that in the present case investigation is over and charge sheet is filed.

The present Applicant has not played any role whatsoever in commission Gurpritsingh @ Gurmitsingh ... vs State Of Gujarat on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175092225/
1 of the offence in question.

sentences.text: The only material connecting the present Applicant in the present offence is his NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/10458/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/06/2024 undefined acquaintance with the main accsued Bharat @ Bobby Rambhai Patel (hereinafter referred to as "Bobby").
Except this there is no other material whatsoever connecting the Applicant in commission of the offence in question.
The present Applicant has not obtained or forged any Visas for sending any of his clients to United States of America ("USA").
The present Applicant is in the business of Visa Consultancy for the European Counteries only, that too lawfully.
The present Applicant does not provide any service for the Visas of USA.
As per the case of the prosecution, the present Applicant had played an active role in providing Visas of European Countries to the victims.
On the basis of the said Visas those victims had gone to European Countries and from there they had gone to Mexico and from Mexico they had entered the territories of USA.
The Applicant is not associated in any manner in entrance of the victims to the territories of USA unauthorizedly.

He submitted that as per the case of the prosecution, 87 Passports had been recovered from the main accused at Ahmedabad, whereas, the Applicant is the resident of Delhi, and therefore, no such material has been recovered from the present Applicant.
Out of 87 Passports, which have been recovered from the main accused, only 5 Passports were found to be forged.
The Applicant had not played any role so far as those 5 forged Passports were concerned.
The Applicant is ready and willing to deposit the requisite amount before the concerned Trial Court.
He has further submitted that the Applicant has good reputation in the society and no useful purpose would be served by keeping the applicant in jail for indefinite period.
It is further contended that the applicant is ready and willing to abide by all the conditions that may be imposed by this Court if released on bail.

4. Per contra, learned APP Mr. Manan Mehta has vehemently opposed the present application for grant of regular bail contending that the Applicant had played an active role in commission of the offence in question.

The Applicant was involved in the illegal activities of humabn trafficking and was involved in NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/10458/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/06/2024 undefined sending the persons to USA unauthorizedly.
The bail application filed by the other coaccused persons have been dismissed by this Court.
Learned APP has therefore submitted that looking to the nature of offence, this Court may not exercise the discretion in favour of the applicant and the Application may be dismissed.
5. Heard learned Advocates for the respective parties and perused the record.
From perusal of the record, it appears that the present Applicant was working with the main accused namely Bobby.
The said Bobby is the kingpin in the present offence.
The Applicant being the associate of the said Bobby is involved in the present offence.
From the record it appears that the said Bobby sent the amounts to Delhi through angadia.
The said amounts were subsequently received by the present Applicant in Delhi.
The statement of the owner of the angadia reveals that the said Bobby had transferred the sum of Rs. 7,72,00,000/- to Delhi, out of which an amount of Rs.7,65,21,000/- has been withdrawn.
The statement of the owner of angadia pedhi indicates that the amount which was being sent by the said Bobby was collected from Delhi either by the Applicant or his aide on his behalf.
This indicates that the present Applicant was working in tendem with the main accused Bobby.
6. The investigating agency has recorded the statement of Rakesh Hoshiyarsinh Yadav during the course of investigation.
This witness happens to be the close friend of the present Applicant.

He as a Gurpritsingh @ Gurmitsingh ... vs State Of Gujarat on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175092225/
2 witness has stated that the present Applicant was engaged in the activity of illegal immigration and previously also he was involved in such activities.

sentences.text: After the period corona pandemic, the Applicant had again indulged into such activities.

He also states that the present Applicant had forwarded several other forged documents to this witness and had asked him to help these persons to enter the European Countries by getting their Visas done on the basis of the said forged documents, which indicates that the Applicant is involved in such activities.
 
 R/CR.MA/10458/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/06/2024  
7.

The record further indicates that, as per the modus operandi, the persons who had contacted the main accused Bobby, were provided Visas of the European Countries on the basis of the forged documents which were forwarded by them.
The procedure for Visas of European Countries was undertaken by the present Applicant.
After obtaining the Visas, those persons used to visit European Countries and from there they would go to Mexico and from Mexico they would unauthorizedly travel to USA.
Thus, in the opinion of this Court, the present is a large scale human trafficking racket.
8. Having regard to the aforesaid aspects, no case is made out to exercise discretion in favour of the Applicant.
The Application is therefore dismissed.

(M. R. MENGDEY,J) J.N.W / 76 Gurpritsingh @ Gurmitsingh ... vs State Of Gujarat on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175092225/
